independence_statement: Reviewer did not author or edit the candidate README, scope delta, source manifest, source snapshots, validation or navigation. Reviewer requested a concrete stale-hash repair; root applied it; reviewer retested the final exact bytes. Only independent evidence and this review were written by the reviewer.
scope: Bounded additive planning reconciliation for Tumbler and Midnight Man, including source provenance, preserved history, counts, task mapping, next deliverables and approval boundaries. No new visual, native, balance or release acceptance.
score_method: Minimum of applicable document-review dimensions; no averaging or rounding. Ten means every required check in this stated document scope is satisfied by inspected evidence.

policy.interpretation: Strongest applicable document gates retained. Visual reference and native specialist dimensions are not scored or closed by this review.

candidate_identity.binding_rule: This review binds the exact local candidate files below. A separate publication receipt must bind their read-back commit; this report does not claim publication.

applicable_dimensions.name: Source-defined abilities and uncertainties
applicable_dimensions.evidence: Four complete source texts were read and exact local hashes/direct Git commit paths checked; all baseline mechanics and open decisions remain faithful.

applicable_dimensions.name: Identity, availability and counts
applicable_dimensions.evidence: Two distinct additions preserve the old 99-family snapshot; exact 101/2/11/5 arithmetic is separated from unlock and implementation claims.

applicable_dimensions.name: Historical preservation and source precedence
applicable_dimensions.evidence: All 305 non-navigation original files are exact local and remote blobs; three navigation diffs are bounded; Snow Truck/Tumbler and VC01/VC02 boundaries remain explicit.

applicable_dimensions.name: Task ownership and dependency integrity
applicable_dimensions.evidence: All 35 exact mappings match; named Midnight work remains unassigned; no graph edits, invented tasks or reused character gate.

applicable_dimensions.name: Meaningful future upgrade value
applicable_dimensions.evidence: Future purchases require additional value and visible operational change beyond baseline abilities; no authored numeric tiers are implied.

applicable_dimensions.name: Acceptance scope, milestones and resumption
applicable_dimensions.evidence: Fourteen requirements and sixteen document/future checks are explicit; five milestones and four deliverables have valid acyclic dependencies; receipts and next actions are named.

applicable_dimensions.name: Exact evidence binding and navigation
applicable_dimensions.evidence: Final candidate and validation hashes match; source binding repair is closed; 26 local links resolve.

applicable_dimensions.name: Approval and evidence boundaries
applicable_dimensions.evidence: New art, native, motion/audio, ownership assignment, numerical unlocks and release evidence remain unapproved; no prior score is transferred.

items.name: Distinct additive identities
items.evidence: Exactly two local planning identities are added. Man is an alias of Midnight Man. Canonical runtime IDs and runtime slots remain undefined.

items.name: Availability boundary
items.evidence: Tumbler is source-assigned to World 1. Midnight Man is the fifth planned playable identity, with world/release availability and unlock explicitly unassigned.

items.name: Historical preservation
items.evidence: Actual historical data and hashes retain 99 families, 27 ladders, 54 stages, seven presentation files, 24 panels and 38 conditional-family dispositions. The two additions remain upgrade-disposition pending; 101 is tracked coverage, not confirmed World 1 unlocks.

items.name: Source-defined Tumbler baseline
items.evidence: Tumbler text faithfully retains twin flat horizontal front cutters, eligible enemy/tree/all-mineable interaction, named paid-camp safety, explicit Launch, up to 10 distinct eligible targets, assigned-target homing and one shared three-second cooldown after successful volleys.

items.name: Source-defined Tumbler custody
items.evidence: Armored rear hatch above the turbine, typed custody, exactly-once warehouse receipt and inside/outside wreck rules remain source-defined. Cargo examples are not a capacity limit; blocked unload/save-reload tests remain future evidence.

items.name: No unspecified vehicle inheritance
items.evidence: The old generic vehicle baseline is narrowed to Snow Truck. No fuel/power, unlimited cargo, hull geometry, garage fit, unlock or bill is silently inherited by Tumbler. Both VC01 and VC02 remain unresolved.

items.name: Source-defined Midnight Man baseline
items.evidence: Batarang target classes, the complete Sweep and Breakthrough sequences, and the proposed Rebound sequence match the actual source text. Character-specific kit leaves standard player orbiting axes and survivor two-handed tools unchanged.

items.name: Open character controls
items.evidence: Throw trigger, target priority, cadence, damage, range, controls, world availability and unlock remain open. Rebound hybrid-versus-all-melee remains an explicit decision.

items.name: Real future purchase value
items.evidence: The future brief contract requires an additional gain beyond baseline, a visible mechanism, requirements, action/material flow, access consequences and tradeoff. Existing cutters, volley, cargo, batarangs and combo concepts are explicitly excluded from being sold as newly unlocked abilities.

items.name: No new tiers or balance figures
items.evidence: No equipment tier, appearance tier, runtime ID, new price, damage/range/capacity/power value or numeric unlock is created. The only operational figures retained here, 10 targets and three seconds, are explicit source baseline figures.

items.name: Task identity preservation
items.evidence: All 35 mapped existing task names, forward titles and ordered dependency arrays match the retained task delta exactly. T53 covers owned local vehicle integration; T20 stays customer traffic. Existing Character 1-4 gates remain intact. Midnight Man has a named unassigned work item with no canonical T-number, no new graph edges and no NPC/escort slot. T53 release-gate reconciliation and T71-T80 gaps remain explicit.

items.name: Native evidence remains separate
items.evidence: The document requires actual models/rigs, complete action cycles, normal-camera footage, mineable/target/custody tests, one harvest receipt per accepted event, audio and applicable device/reference gates before gameplay support. It grants none of those approvals.

items.name: Existing settlement scope
items.evidence: The 10-by-50 plan, storage-house value, multiple simultaneous pets/survivors, paid loss/recovery boundaries, existing furnace/storehouse forms and selected conveyor/resource scale are retained. The staged three-pet/two-escort proposal is not newly ratified, and Midnight Man does not alter companion counts.

items.name: Image evidence limit
items.evidence: Two JPGs are pinned only by immutable path/blob/size metadata. Neither was downloaded or visually inspected in this reconciliation, and the old seven-image approval is not extended.
